title: helianthus annuus var. argophyllus
intro: Helianthus annuus var. argophyllus, commonly known as Silver Sunflower, is a subspecies of the common sunflower (Helianthus annuus) that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Silver Sunflower include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Silver Sunflower may also possess neuroprotective and antiviral properties, further supporting its potential therapeutic applications.
